column1: # OWASP ZAP rules for the nightly API scan (.github/workflows/nightly.yml, "DAST"). Tab-separated:
# rule ID, then IGNORE, WARN or FAIL, then a note. Rules not listed are WARN, and the job fails on any
# WARN or FAIL alert, so a new finding fails the run. Only IGNORE what was reviewed, and say why.
# Unknown paths get Django's HTML 404 page rather than JSON. The API's own routes return JSON.
# Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy only restricts no-cors loads (,
# can't add the Authorization header every data route needs, so they only ever get a 401.
# DOM XSS drives a browser over HTML pages; the API serves none, and the browser can crash ZAP.
# The scanned stack serves plain HTTP. In production, HTTPS is the reverse proxy's (Nginx or an ALB, see
